title: Lecturer on Law
bio: David Zimmer is a partner at Zimmer, Citron & Clarke, which he co-founded in 2025. David has extensive experience representing clients in appeals and complex civil litigation. David has argued or second-chaired seven merits cases at the U.S. Supreme Court and dozens of appeals in federal and state appellate courts across the country. He also […]
